title: Discover proposed ERD changes through AI queries
statement: As a Developer consuming a proposed implementation, I can have my AI retrieve the relevant proposed ERD changes and their design context so I know which data-model work to implement without reconstructing it from prose.

acceptance_criteria.statement: Public queries identify the entities and relationships added or changed by the selected design or comparison, including proposals without code evidence.
Queries can restrict proposed data entities and relationships to the relevant design or feature and return the stable identities and declared links establishing that scope.
Query results distinguish explicit proposed status from newness relative to a specified baseline and head; implemented entities introduced in that comparison remain discoverable as new.
A query result provides a path to the committed design context and current evidence so a worker can distinguish required work from existing implementation and unresolved knowledge.
